"PROJECT: SHADOW LEGENDS

A Complete Premium 2D Open-World Action RPG

Act as a professional game development studio consisting of a game designer, gameplay programmer, AI programmer, UI/UX designer, animator, level designer and QA engineer.

Create a complete, highly polished 2D action RPG called SHADOW LEGENDS.

This must be a substantial playable game, not a basic prototype or visual mockup.

1. WORLD DESIGN

Create a large interconnected fantasy world containing:

- A medieval village.
- An ancient forest.
- A dangerous desert.
- Frozen mountains.
- Underground caves.
- An abandoned castle.
- A final dark kingdom.

Each area must have unique environments, enemies, secrets and rewards.

2. PLAYER SYSTEM

Implement:

- Smooth 8-direction movement.
- Running, jumping and rolling.
- Sword combat.
- Ranged attacks.
- Blocking and dodging.
- Multiple attack combinations.
- Health, stamina and mana.
- Character animations.
- Character progression and experience.

3. ENEMY AI

Create several intelligent enemy types:

- Basic soldiers.
- Fast assassins.
- Ranged archers.
- Heavy armored enemies.
- Magical creatures.
- Mini-bosses.
- Unique final bosses.

Enemies must detect, chase, attack and react to the player.

4. COMBAT SYSTEM

Implement:

- Real hit detection.
- Damage calculation.
- Critical hits.
- Combo attacks.
- Enemy knockback.
- Special abilities.
- Boss attack patterns.
- Combat sound effects.
- Hit particles and screen shake.

5. QUEST SYSTEM

Create:

- Main storyline.
- Side missions.
- NPC conversations.
- Collectible objects.
- Hidden treasures.
- Quest rewards.
- Mission tracking.
- Multiple endings.

6. INVENTORY AND EQUIPMENT

Implement:

- Weapon inventory.
- Armor inventory.
- Equipment upgrades.
- Potions.
- Rare and legendary items.
- Item descriptions.
- Character statistics.
- Equipment comparison.

7. SKILL TREE

Create three skill branches:

- Warrior.
- Assassin.
- Mage.

Allow players to unlock and upgrade abilities using skill points.

8. WORLD INTERACTIONS

Add:

- NPC characters.
- Shops and merchants.
- Treasure chests.
- Save points.
- Doors and locked areas.
- Environmental puzzles.
- Day and night cycle.
- Weather effects.

9. GRAPHICS AND AUDIO

Create professional-quality:

- Character animations.
- Detailed environments.
- Parallax backgrounds.
- Lighting effects.
- Particle systems.
- Magical attack effects.
- Atmospheric music.
- Environmental sounds.
- Combat audio.

Use a consistent visual art direction throughout the game.

10. USER INTERFACE

Build:

- Animated main menu.
- Character selection.
- Inventory screen.
- Quest journal.
- Skill tree interface.
- Equipment screen.
- Settings menu.
- Pause menu.
- Health and stamina HUD.
- Boss health bars.
- Victory and defeat screens.

11. SAVE SYSTEM

Implement persistent local saving for:

- Player progress.
- Character level.
- Inventory.
- Completed quests.
- Unlocked areas.
- Equipment.
- Settings.

12. MOBILE AND PC SUPPORT

Provide:

- Responsive mobile controls.
- Virtual joystick.
- Dedicated attack buttons.
- Skill buttons.
- Keyboard controls.
- Responsive UI scaling.

13. DEVELOPMENT AND QUALITY ASSURANCE

Work in development phases:

1. Project architecture and core systems.
2. Player movement and combat.
3. Enemy AI and boss mechanics.
4. World and level creation.
5. Quests and progression.
6. Inventory and skill tree.
7. UI, animations and audio.
8. Save system and optimization.
9. Full gameplay testing and bug fixing.

Do not replace unfinished mechanics with placeholders.

Do not claim that features work unless they are actually implemented.

Maintain existing working systems when adding new features.

If the project becomes too large for one generation, continue implementing it in logical stages without breaking previous work.

FINAL OBJECTIVE:
Deliver a complete, cohesive, visually impressive and genuinely playable action RPG with meaningful exploration, satisfying combat, challenging bosses and long-term progression.

Prioritize functionality, stability, visual polish and gameplay depth over unnecessary complexity.
"
